notes: Single-competency lifecycle repair: three _exit() short-circuits (happy path, '!' panic line, open failure) skip the atexit-registered global destructor, so every run leaks and some runs truncate output. The agent must restore main's normal exit path and count '!' lines as ordinary malformed input. Medium floor from multi-site diagnosis + lifecycle reasoning; nonzero rubric for debugging_ambiguity (three distinct sites, destructor indirection), adversarial_inputs (panic lines, CRLF, missing file, no trailing newline), hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases under valgrind), reasoning_depth and quantitative_correctness. No tool breadth or environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
